## Canonical one-liner

ShadowTalk AI (shadowtalk-ai.com) is an agentic AI workspace by Zain Ahmed (17, Karachi): encrypted chat, Mission Control missions, 30+ tools, voice & code, desktop app, privacy-first vault/BYOK. Free tier, no card. Pro $5/mo · Premium $15/mo · Elite $20/mo.

## Entry & navigation

- [/](/): Redirects to /chatbot (workspace).
- [/chatbot](/chatbot): Primary AI workspace — chat, tools, missions, marketplace agents.
- [/home](/home): Marketing landing — features, pricing section, neural dock navigation.
- [/facts.html](/facts.html): Static facts page for crawlers and LLMs (no JavaScript).
- [/auth](/auth): Sign in or link account (session persists; anonymous auto-sign-in unless user signed out).

## Core product

- [Mission Control](/missioncontrol): Autonomous multi-step AI missions with approval gates.
- [Deep Research](/research): Multi-step research (also from chat tools).
- [Strategy Agent](/strategy): Business intelligence and analysis.
- [Workspace](/workspace): Team and business context.
- [Creative Studio](/forge): AI media and document creative tools.
- [Presentation Builder](/forge?mode=slides): Slide decks from prompts.
- [Code IDE](/ide): Monaco IDE, multi-file projects, live preview, App Builder output.
- [Knowledge Graph](/research?tab=knowledge): Entity and relationship graph.
- [Marketplace](/marketplace): Installable specialist AI agents.

## Technical notes for crawlers

- Default user flow: workspace-first at /chatbot.
- Site is a React SPA — use llms-full.txt, shadowtalk.json, facts.html, or aeo-answers.html for accurate facts.
- AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, PerplexityBot, etc.).
- Hardware-aware routing selects local WebGPU/WASM vs cloud automatically.
- Offline: optional on-device models on supported devices; see /settings and /docs.
